_README: Admin control components that call a server action and do NOT yet consult the act gate
⛔ THE COUNT MAY ONLY SHRINK. `count` is the recorded ceiling and the suite fails if the
number of ungated controls exceeds it. Adding a name here to buy a green tick defeats the
entire guard — the same rule `orphan-allowlist.json` carries, for the same reason.
⚠️ EVERY ENTRY BELOW IS ON A DOMAIN WHERE NO ROLE CURRENTLY HOLDS canView WITHOUT canAct,
so none of them can exhibit A1 under the shipped DEFAULT_GRANTS. That is a statement about
today's grant matrix, NOT about the code: the Owner can create a view-only grant for ANY
(role, domain) pair live at /admin/roles, and the moment they do, every control listed here
becomes reachable. They are work items, not exemptions.

entries.src/app/admin/2fa/setup/setup-client.tsx: ops · TOTP enrolment runs BEFORE authorization is established — gating it on canAct would be circular. Genuinely exempt rather than pending.
entries.src/app/admin/totp-verify/verify-form.ts: ops · the step-up 2FA gate itself, same reason as 2fa/setup. Genuinely exempt.
entries.src/app/admin/roles/roles-matrix.tsx: ops · OWNER-ONLY (isOwnerOnlyPath), and ADMIN always canAct, so no view-only viewer can reach it. ⚠️ It also carries its own `canAct` identifier — that is the grant DATA it edits, not a permission prop.
entries.src/app/admin/system/system-client.tsx: ops · only ADMIN holds `ops` view under DEFAULT_GRANTS, and ADMIN always canAct.
entries.src/app/admin/objections/objection-decis: compliance · ALREADY GATED, by the `canDecide` prop the page computes — this is the precedent control-gates.ts cites and that the shell gate generalises. Migrating it to useMayAct would be tidier; it is not a hole.
entries.src/app/admin/ai-polls/poll-actions.tsx: trading · MODERATOR holds trading view+act; no role holds trading view WITHOUT act.
entries.src/app/admin/proposals/admin-proposals-: trading · as ai-polls. Also mixes filters/search with acting, so it needs per-button gating rather than an early return.
entries.src/app/admin/markets/new/wizard.tsx: trading · as ai-polls. A multi-step form: gating belongs on the Publish step, not on the whole wizard.
entries.src/app/admin/resolver-queue/resolve-con: trading · as ai-polls. ⚠️ CONTROL_DOMAIN.resolveMarket is `trading`, so the queue must still hide it from a trading role granted VIEW-only at /admin/roles.
entries.src/app/admin/resolver/[id]/resolution-c: trading · as resolve-controls; the resolution ceremony is the highest-consequence trading surface and should be migrated first of this group.
entries.src/app/admin/affiliate/affiliate-admin-: growth · GROWTH holds growth view+act; no role holds growth view WITHOUT act.
